# High-edge SFD-transition recording

English · [简体中文](说明.md)

Actual Pager transmission at nominal −9 dBm, recorded at 1.75 MS/s. The complete short burst was missed by the earlier margin rule. A local blind joint-transition prototype subsequently passed this segment; ARM and fresh RF qualification were still pending at the fixture's date.

After the quarter ending, a data symbol can retain downchirp projection in a short window, so a fixed 5 dB end-drop rule rejects a legitimate transition. A replacement must still reject incorrect SFD lengths, continuous downchirps, periodic FSK and incorrect synchronization; deleting the ending gate is not an acceptable correction. Hashes and exact source coordinates are in `provenance.json`. This fixture does not establish received payload or CRC.
